pages.name: Frostbitten
pages.text: $(bold)Threat:$() moderate. Ice and flash-frozen tissue. Not here before Phase 4.

pages.title: Field Notes
pages.text: $(li)Spawns on the surface, Phase 4+$(li)Throws heavy snowballs$(li)Melee applies freeze$(li)Avoids light level 10+$(br2)$(flavor)Exhibit A: 200+ heat signatures that should not exist. Exhibit B: our confused faces.$()

pages.title: Fighting
pages.text: $(bold)Weak to:$() fire, Acheronite weapons$(br2)$(bold)Drops:$() Frozen Meat, $(l:heating/thermal_capacitor)Frostbitten Core$(/l)$(br2)$(flavor)Avoid melee unless you enjoy hypothermia.$()
